resources.string: Ask for Face ID, Touch ID or BiometricPrompt when you open a protected screen. Optional.
Turning this off gives access to no server credential. Server authentication stays independent from this device setting.

Cover the transcript when the app goes to the background. On by default.
Ask the OS to block captures. Off by default; independent from the app-switcher cover.
On Android this blocks screenshots and screen recording too (FLAG_SECURE). The app-switcher cover stays available either way.
